Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
I'm hoping this message will be responded to before 1:00 PST as
that is when we will begin playing. It would be nice to have this
question answered before then.

When do you play the card Cats Guidance at the minor???

1/after the block is announced and before the actual combat
begins (before choose range)

2/After the block is resolved (after combat is over)

Secondly can you play a second CG if the minion you block plays
Form Of Mist at the superior. or does this violate the rule of playing
duplicate reaction cards for the same action???

Cheers, Karl

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Karl Innes <in...@infomatch.com> writes:
>I'm hoping this message will be responded to before 1:00 PST as
>that is when we will begin playing. It would be nice to have this
>question answered before then.

> When do you play the card Cats Guidance at the minor???

> 1/after the block is announced and before the actual combat
>begins (before choose range)

> 2/After the block is resolved (after combat is over)

1/ is correct. The block *is* completely resolved by the time
the combat begins (the Combat is completely separatae from the block).

> Secondly can you play a second CG if the minion you block plays
>Form Of Mist at the superior. or does this violate the rule of playing
>duplicate reaction cards for the same action???

No. It is a violation of the duplicate reaction card restriction.
